answer: A “juniper” node inserts random spot‑check questions into each agent’s workflow, drawing from a vetted “voyage” of known tasks whose answers are secretly stored in a tamper‑proof quill ledger; the agent must answer correctly to earn credit for that interval. If an identity fails any check, its reputation score drops below the activation threshold and all its pending transactions are frozen. An attacker must lock 10 tokens per identity as a bond and forfeit 5 tokens each time a check fails, making the marginal cost of a usable Sybil identity at least 15 tokens.
